classification.difficultyReason: Decompose two supplied constant cross-sections into familiar plane shapes before ordinary prism multiplication.

content.prompt: Find the volume of each solid.

spec.description: Explicit concave stepped prism: front total25 by20, highledge15, lowledge10 and15height, drop5, extrusion50. All seven source dimensions retained; source corresponds to actual constant-section extrusion.
spec.answerVisibility: Original given measures only, no computed answer labels.

answer.worked:
The cross-section is two rectangles, of widths 15 cm and 10 cm.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=15(20)+10(15)=450\text{ cm}^2\\V&=450(50)=22500\text{ cm}^3.\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Explicit house-shaped prism, rectangle6by10 plus trianglebase6height3, extrusion30.
spec.answerVisibility: Original given measures only, no computed answer labels.

answer.worked:
Add the rectangular and triangular cross-section areas, then multiply by the prism length.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=6(10)+\tfrac12(6)(3)=69\text{ m}^2\\V&=69(30)=2070\text{ m}^3.\end{aligned}$$
